Reading the record

How the numbers are counted

Recorded spend adds published payments and subtracts published refunds. A quotation or bill alone does not change the total.

A workday is a date with confirmed work attendance. Worker-days add the people recorded on those dates. A missing date is unknown, not a day off.

Material quantities retain their item, specification, unit and event type. Buying steel does not prove it was delivered or installed.

Historical notes reconstructed later will be labelled. Supporting evidence is reviewed before a public entry is added.
